requirements.description: City prefers to enter into an agreement with a single vendor that can demonstrate organizational, functional, and technical capabilities to perform the complete range of services and meet or exceed requirements and service levels specified.
requirements.evidence_text: It is the City’s preference to enter into an agreement with a single vendor who can demonstrate that they possess the organizational, functional, and technical capabilities to perform the complete range of services and meet or exceed the requirements and service levels specified herein.

requirements.description: Proposer must have a solid customer base utilizing the proposed solution within Washington State, including cities similar in size and service delivery to Snoqualmie.
requirements.evidence_text: Solid customer base utilizing the proposed solution within Washington State, including cities similar in size and service delivery to Snoqualmie.

requirements.description: Proposer must have successful experience implementing the proposed software in Washington to fully comply with BARS tracking and reporting requirements.
requirements.evidence_text: Successful experience implementing the proposed software in Washington to fully comply with BARS tracking and reporting requirements.

requirements.description: Proposer must meet all functional and technical requirements stated within this RFP using commercial off-the-shelf software.
requirements.evidence_text: Meet all functional and technical requirements stated within this RFP using commercial off-the-shelf software.

requirements.description: Successful supplier shall be responsible for final City approved design, installation, and implementation of the ERP system including development of user acceptance testing, system integration and connectivity to existing resources.
requirements.evidence_text: The successful supplier shall be responsible for the final City approved design, installation, and implementation of the ERP system including development of user acceptance testing, system integration and connectivity to existing resources.

requirements.description: If an on premise solution is proposed, the proposer must leverage a Microsoft-centric architecture supporting Microsoft SQL Server database and the City’s technology direction.
requirements.evidence_text: Leverage Microsoft-centric architecture supporting Microsoft SQL Server database and the City’s technology direction (if on premise solution is proposed).

requirements.description: Project approach and understanding of the City’s objectives and requirements will be considered in selection.
requirements.evidence_text: Project approach and understanding of the City’s objectives and requirements

requirements.description: Supplier’s implementation methodology and success will be considered in selection.
Feedback from customer references will be considered in selection.
Compliance with the City’s terms and conditions will be considered in selection.
requirements.evidence_text: Compliance with the City’s terms and conditions

requirements.description: Ability to meet the City’s requirements for software functionality, usability, performance, flexibility, integration, and technology will be considered in selection.
requirements.evidence_text: Ability to meet the City’s requirements (software functionality, usability, performance, flexibility, integration, and technology)

requirements.description: Supplier’s installed base and experience with municipalities similar to the City of Snoqualmie will be considered in selection.
requirements.evidence_text: Supplier’s installed base and experience with municipalities similar to the City of Snoqualmie

requirements.description: Integration with ESRI ArcGIS, MaintStar, TRAKit, and external payment processors will be considered in selection.
requirements.evidence_text: Integration with ESRI ArcGIS, MaintStar, TRAKit, and external payment processors.

requirements.description: Cost and support quality for ongoing maintenance and support will be considered in selection.
requirements.evidence_text: Cost and support quality for ongoing maintenance and support

requirements.description: The ERP system must provide integration with a budgeting analytics and planning tool to be selected as part of the RFP process.
requirements.evidence_text: Integration with a budgeting analytics and planning tool to be selected as part of the RFP process.

requirements.description: The ERP system must be highly intuitive with minimal training from a user perspective to improve cross departmental performance and efficiency.
requirements.evidence_text: A highly intuitive system with minimal training from a user perspective in order to improve cross departmental performance and efficiency.
